'''Cosians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] bipeds who had beaked mouths, four-fingered [[Limb/Legends|hands]], hair, and a long, muscular tail ending with a tuft of hair. They were capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] was a Cosian.
